subs.text: Graham — this is your brand, your name, your photos, your voice.
We just gave it somewhere to live.
Run zone, stations prep, taper zone — your coaching, structured like a season.
Your story — the gym, the races, the AGAIN mentality. Not a template with a logo swapped.
Coaching plans front and centre. One click and they're applying to train with you.
Your race calendar, your crew, the Elation community — all under one roof.
The Warriors Wall — race faces, finish-line tears, the squad being daft.
Members send their shots, you approve, it goes up. Community that builds itself.
The stuff that's not in the rulebook. Your actual race-day knowledge, in your voice.
Ask Graham — questions come to you properly, not buried in DMs.
Click Coaching and it takes you here — applications, not a payment link.
Find a race-mate. Doubles partners pair up on your site — it keeps them coming back.
They post a card, find each other. Zero admin for you.
Race Tools menu — click Race predictor and it takes you here.
They put in a time, it tells them their predicted finish. Your site becomes the tool they train with.
Click Split analyser and it takes you here — paste a result, get a station-by-station breakdown.
Instant analysis. That used to be a spreadsheet — now it's the reason people join your list.
Results board — your times, your members' times, all in one place.
Stations prep — all eight stations, coached in your voice, shot with your race photos.
Run zone — pacing, compromised running, the work between the stations.
Taper zone — the week before race day, done properly.
Race calendar — where you're competing, where the Elation crew is heading.
Race crew meetups — the ninth station. Your community, organised on your own platform.
UK HYROX news — fresh content under your name. Google loves this part.
Partners page — Built for Athletes, Myprotein, and your own Elation training hub.
Click the Built for Athletes button and it takes you straight to their store — your ELATION code already in the link.
Click Myprotein — same again. Every partner click is a conversion path, not a dead link.
That's the difference from a Linktree — traffic that starts on your brand, not borrowed from it.
Join the list — every visitor becomes a contact you own, not an audience you rent.
And the bit nobody builds for coaches — the Desk.
Coaching income, race costs, affiliate earnings — one view. No spreadsheet.
It runs itself. You coach; it keeps score.
Everything you sell, everything the Elation community needs — under your name.
Have a look around, Graham. Would love to hear what you think.
